title: Freeboard
about: Walk your ship, take the helm and make a living trading, patrolling or surveying three worlds.
help: Walk forward from the airlock to the bridge with WASD or the left stick. Drag the view or use the arrow keys to look around. Use F or the nearby prompt at the pilot seat. Choose a contract and undock. Aim with the mouse, arrows or stick. W adds thrust, S brakes, Shift boosts and Space fires. Use F or Leave the seat to hold position and walk through the ship. Back at the airlock while docked, use the port terminal to trade or refit. On a survey, hold Sample or Space near each of three crystals, then return to the ship.
